messages:
Maya: Heads up — quickstart sampleapp hitting bursts of 429s during combined pagination + batch embeddings flow. Repro in ~15s.
Ravi: Can you share a tiny repro and logs?
Maya: Steps: run node sampleapp quickstart, call /import which paginates articles with PREFETCH=2. Each page handler calls embeddings.batch() and sometimes a small generation. After a few pages we see repeated 429s.
Maya: Log extract: 2026-11-02T09:41:12Z ERROR fetch status=429 route=/v1/embeddings model=text-embed-001 inflight=7
Tess: Which SDK version?
Maya: sdk-js 0.10.1. Also saw a milder case in go-sample where per-route limits helped.
Ben: Sounds like prefetch + client token bucket bursting. Prefetch spawns parallel page processors, each issues embed calls -> large short burst -> bucket drained -> server 429 -> SDK retries cause more bursts.
Ravi: We moved to a per-client adaptive-window a while ago, right? That could make cross-route bursts worse.
Tess: Quick mitigation: set REDWOOD_SDK_PREFETCH_PAGES=1 or client option {maxConcurrency:2}. We should update quickstart docs.
Maya: Confirmed: setting PREFETCH=1 reduces repro.
Ben: Proposed fixes: (1) default quickstart prefetch=1, (2) implement per-route token buckets in JS SDK to match Go, (3) improve retry jitter and cap retry concurrency.
Ravi: I'll pick up the SDK change. Will add an integration test that paginates and parallel-embeds and asserts <5 429s in 60s.
Tess: I'll add a note in onboarding docs and a short FAQ entry.
OpsBot: created deployment plan for branch devex/prefetch-fix -> staging (ci-42).
Maya: Also adding a Console telemetry flag to surface single-session multi-route 429 spikes.
Ben: Filed ticket DEVEX-5798 and assigned to @Ravi, priority P2.
Ravi: Will send PR for per-route buckets + tests, ping QA.
Maya: Thanks — leaving this thread for follow-ups on docs/telemetry/tests.
